name: Fireflies
tested: offline only (fake network); not yet run against a real account
gaps: GraphQL field arguments are mapped one level deep. Fields of input object types (for example CreateAskFredThreadInput, ShareMeetingInput) are documented on /schema/input/* pages that were not mapped.
Every GraphQL argument is recorded with in 'body' because GraphQL sends all arguments in the request body. The body flag is true for every operation for the same reason.
Realtime API (WebSocket event stream), Webhooks V1 and V2 (event subscriptions, not request endpoints) and the MCP server tools are not mapped.
Response selection sets are not mapped.
